The '''Ando Demilitarization Observation Group''' was a [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] organization sent to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Ando/Legends|Ando]] due to the constant violence erupting across the world. [[Jedi Master/Legends|Master]] [[Jorus C'baoth]] of the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] served as one of the group's primary observers.

==Behind the scenes==
When asked on Twitter if the Observation Group was linked with the [[Andoan Wars/Legends|Andoan Wars]] mentioned in ''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]'', the book's authors [[Daniel Wallace]] and [[Jason Fry]] answered this was "likely"<ref name="Tweedle Dee">{{Twitter|danwall88|status/284410969948577793|[[Daniel Wallace]]|quote=@reeldefiction I'd say it's likely but would have to defer the question to Jason for a definitive answer.|archivefile=File:DanWallace-Ando-December-28-2012.png}}</ref> and "a fair assumption."<ref name="Tweedle Dum">{{Twitter|jasoncfry|status/284763002111152128|[[Jason Fry]]|nobackup=1}}</ref>
